concept.title: Figures and diagrams
concept.shortdesc: Figures carry GOV.UK-styled captions, and the DITA SVG domain embeds scalable diagrams that stay crisp at any size.

conbody.p: diagramsSVGA figure whose diagram is referenced through a key — the same mechanism the Open Referral UK publications use for hundreds of model diagrams:
The same diagram referenced directly by path:

Local SVG diagrams are inlined as native SVG, so any links inside a diagram are clickable and the artwork stays crisp at any size. Each image also receives an accessible name derived from the figure title, the caption is numbered automatically, and the diagram never overflows the content column. Set govuk.svg.inline=no to keep the plain image rendering instead.
